text.en:
Killing Elemental-Debuffed targets or scoring 3 Elemental Kills grants this weapon one stack of Ancillary Ordinance. Maximum of #e${4+#d} stacks.

Stacks can be earned while stowed.

Kills consume a stack of Ancillary Ordinance to release a seeking Micro-Missile from the enemy's point of death, traveling up to 30 meters before dealing <pve 330 /> <pvp [100] /> damage in a small radius.

Killing Elemental-Debuffed Targets with this weapon instantly spawns a missile.

enhanced (
var d = 1
#e Increases maximum number of stacks.
)

Killing Elemental-Debuffed Targets with this weapon instantly spawns a missile.
